advice_items.quote: start small with what I started buying houses and I just kept building it up
advice_items.summary_en: Start small by buying houses and scale up gradually into larger commercial properties.
advice_items.summary_zh: 小房起步滚雪球做大地产

advice_items.quote: when someone's selling something they're getting rid of a problem and you have to find out what the problem is then you have to create a strategy of how to exit
advice_items.summary_en: Identify the underlying problem a seller is offloading and map out your profit and exit strategy before buying.
advice_items.summary_zh: 看清卖家痛点并规划退出策略

advice_items.quote: you never tell the bank everything... if there's a problem just tell them what they want to hear
advice_items.summary_en: Be strategic about financial disclosures to banks rather than volunteering every issue unnecessarily.
advice_items.summary_zh: 向银行策略性报喜不报忧

advice_items.quote: they want to do quick quick things it takes time got to work hard stay focused
advice_items.summary_en: Reject overnight-success impatience; building real wealth requires sustained hard work and focus over time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持专注并脚踏实地长期苦干

guests.first_money_or_break: 22岁时靠微薄资金（on a shoestring）开了两家珠宝店，亲自在街头推销、批发零售并前往意大利进货；随后从买小房子起步深耕地产35年，滚雪球发展到购入大型购物中心，曾在一笔600万美元的投资中赚取约4000万美元。
guests.guest_name: Las Vegas Shopping Center Real Estate Mogul (67yo)
guests.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Investor & Shopping Center Owner
guests.wealth_detail: $40M profit on a $6M deal; bought $25M and $20M shopping centers
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要以为做地产必须先有很多钱，应从买小房子起步逐步积累；同时要脚踏实地长期苦干并保持专注，不要总想走捷径。

advice_items.quote: every hustler has been broke it's how you respond
advice_items.summary_en: Going broke is a normal part of the entrepreneurial hustle; what defines you is how you bounce back.
advice_items.summary_zh: 破产并不可怕关键看如何反弹

advice_items.quote: you got to stay 10 toes down... you're trying to build a long-term brand you got to be in it for the long haul
advice_items.summary_en: Stay fully committed and build with a 50-year brand horizon, strong foundation, and solid team.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚定投入并着眼五十年长期品牌

advice_items.quote: you just got to know your numbers you got to know exactly what you're manufacturing... and make sure that you have all your ducks in a row in order to play in the big leagues
advice_items.summary_en: Know your exact unit costs and margins, and secure working capital and structure before taking on major retail purchase orders.
advice_items.summary_zh: 算清成本利润与现金流再接大单

advice_items.quote: I had to build relationships and affluent communities... you got to go where the action is at... success is about proximity
advice_items.summary_en: Put yourself in affluent rooms and build genuine relationships because people buy from people they like.
advice_items.summary_zh: 走进富裕圈层建立高价值人脉

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: price is only an issue when value is absent
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on delivering unmistakable value so price becomes secondary for buyers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 交付高价值后价格便不再是问题

guests.first_money_or_break: 在洛杉矶卡森贫困社区长大，创业近10年；通过自建印花加工厂（丝网印刷、DTG、DTF）掌握生产端并拉高利润率，最终促成与Nike、Nordstrom的合作订单以及Macy's、Tillys的快闪合作，实现年收入七位数。
guests.guest_name: Los Angeles Samoan-Polynesian Apparel Brand & Print Founder
guests.zero_start_advice: 做好长期深耕品牌的准备并搭建稳固基础与团队；算清制造成本、利润率和备货现金流再承接大订单；主动走出原有环境，去富裕圈层和行业大会建立高价值人脉。

advice_items.quote: you have to put it down like a speeding ticket start the next day brand new it's not your fault and go make your money
advice_items.summary_en: Treat severe financial setbacks like a speeding ticket—move on immediately and start fresh the next day to rebuild.
advice_items.summary_zh: 亏钱受挫后立即翻篇重新赚钱

advice_items.quote: if it's so difficult on the front end you can't get past the first stage fire and move on because there's a lot of good people out there
advice_items.summary_en: Fire overly difficult prospects early in negotiations to protect your energy and prioritize healthy relationships.
advice_items.summary_zh: 果断放弃难缠客户保护合作关系

advice_items.quote: they borrow money from the feds at zero right as example they sell it to you at 10% they hit you with fees
advice_items.summary_en: Understand how banks profit off interest rate spreads and fees rather than assuming they act in your interest.
advice_items.summary_zh: 认清银行利差与费用剥削的本质

advice_items.quote: I do strictly commercial... the bigger the deal it's a lot easier may take a little longer but you've got professionals and the team and the time to pull it off and do it right
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on commercial real estate where larger deals bring professional teams and better execution than residential.
advice_items.summary_zh: 专注商业地产大单借专业团队成事

advice_items.quote: your life's not for sure your business is not for sure... the only thing is for sure is that guy it's all about that vertical line we draw with God
advice_items.summary_en: Anchor your life in faith rather than temporary business, wealth, or circumstances.
advice_items.summary_zh: 商业无常唯有信仰是稳固根基

guests.first_money_or_break: 与兄弟及几名合伙人共同创立INX公司，最终以6亿美元出售给纽约的Presidio公司；此前曾因得克萨斯州政府援引主权豁免权拒付3000万美元合同款而破产，但随后迅速重启并创造巨额财富。
guests.guest_name: INX Co-Founder & Commercial Real Estate Investor (65yo)
guests.role_or_title: Co-Founder of INX & Commercial Real Estate Investor
guests.wealth_detail: $600M company sale (INX to Presidio); lost $30M in Texas contract
guests.zero_start_advice: 遭遇重大亏损或破产后要立刻翻篇，第二天全新出发继续赚钱；若用10万美元投资地产，应避开住宅市场而专注商业地产，依靠专业团队做大单，同时关注政府空置商业楼宇机会。
